title: PlanToolInput
description: Input of the `kai_plan` tool: the agent's WHOLE plan, re-sent in full every time it changes. Display only, not a question: the host answers it immediately.

items.description: Every step of the plan, in order, each with its current status. Send the complete list on every call, not a diff: the latest call replaces the previous plan.

id.description: Stable id for the step. Keep it the same across calls so the display can track the step. Unique within `items`.

label.description: What the step is, in a few words.

status.description: `in_progress` for the step being worked on now (normally at most one), `completed` once it is done, `pending` otherwise.
